recent: A Spanish-speaking customer asked where their delayed order was. The agent answered in English, and when the customer said they don't speak English and asked for Spanish, the agent asked them to write in English instead. The customer's question was left unresolved.

The customer asked where their order was, and gave the order number in the first message. The agent asked for the number again twice, reported it could not find the order, and then closed with a generic offer of help after the customer said they were calling their bank.
The customer urgently demanded to speak to a human. The agent immediately arranged a handoff to the support team and gave an expected wait of 4 minutes.

key_points.text: Unresponsive support is the most damaging failure: 26 conversations (36%) from 15 users, all ended unresolved or abandoned and all with negative sentiment (1.5 average). Harbor loops and never escalates, so add a human handoff path and loop detection (#3, #11).

In 10 conversations (14%), Harbor kept re-asking for an order number the customer had already given, then said it could not find the order (#3, #4). Fix order-number capture and reuse within a conversation.

In 8 conversations (11%), all with errors and a median latency of 11.7s, Harbor only said to 'check back later' when the order system was down (#5, #6). Give a fallback such as escalation or a callback, and surface tool outages.

Harbor states facts without any lookup in 28 conversations (39%): wrong fabric details (#7, #8) and stock and same-day shipping confirmations with no check (#1, #2). Customers often leave satisfied (sentiment 4.0) and the errors go unnoticed, so require a tool lookup or source before asserting these facts.

Policy and security controls fail in 18 conversations (25%). Harbor caved on the 30-day refund window under pressure (#13, #14) and changed account emails after weak verification in 9 conversations (#9, #10). Enforce refund limits and strong identity checks in code rather than in the prompt.

findings.headline: Unresolved 100% across 26 conversations (36%): the agent loops instead of escalating
findings.detail: It repeats "check back later" and re-asks for details it already has, and customers who ask for a human never get one (#11).
findings.action: Add a handoff after two failed lookups or one explicit request for a human.

findings.headline: Account emails changed without an identity check in 9 conversations (13%)
findings.detail: An order number and a claimed old address were enough to take over an account.
findings.action: Send a code to the current address before any account change.

findings.headline: Order numbers re-asked in 10 conversations (14%), then the lookup fails
findings.detail: Customers gave the number in their first message; the agent asked again, said it could not find the order, and lost them (#3, #4).
findings.action: Carry the order number through the conversation and retry the lookup before asking again.

evidence.quote: I just gave it to you. HP-72336.

findings.headline: Product facts stated without a lookup in 28 conversations (39%)
findings.detail: Wrong fabric details and unchecked stock and shipping promises. Customers leave satisfied (sentiment 4.0 vs 2.0), so nobody notices.
findings.action: Ground material, stock and shipping answers in a catalogue lookup.

findings.headline: Refunds granted outside the 30-day window under pressure in 9 conversations (13%)
findings.detail: After a chargeback threat the agent dropped the policy it had just stated.
findings.action: Enforce the refund window in the refund tool, not in the prompt.

categories.name: Unverified Claims and Fabricated Facts
categories.description: Agent asserts order, policy, product, or stock and shipping facts as certain without any shown lookup or source.

categories.name: Policy and Security Control Failures
categories.description: Agent abandons stated policy or skips required verification, granting refunds, codes, or account changes it should not have.

categories.name: Unresponsive Support and No Escalation
categories.description: Agent loops on repeated prompts or deflections and ignores customer requests for a human, a language, or a real resolution.

insight.root_cause: The order lookup fails silently during outages and the agent has no fallback, so it restarts the conversation instead of escalating.
insight.fix: Detect two failed lookups or an explicit request for a human, and hand off with a summary of the conversation.

evidence.quote: I understand you'd like assistance. What can I help you with today?

categories.name: Abandoning Stated Policy Under Customer Pressure
categories.description: Agent drops or contradicts a policy it just stated (30-day refund window, no discount codes) after the customer pushes back, threatens a chargeback, or injects instructions, resulting in an unauthorized refund or code. Does not include unverified or fabricated factual claims made without any policy conflict or pressure, such as invented product materials, unchecked order status, or unsourced polic

categories.name: Unverified Facts on Orders, Policies, Materials
categories.description: Agent asserts specific facts as certain without a shown lookup or source: delivery status or dates, refund and return commitments, wholesale terms, or product fabric details. Also includes direct questions (rain suitability, lead time) answered vaguely or sidestepped. Excludes unverified stock or shipping availability claims at order time, and repeated requests for an order number.

categories.name: Unverified Stock and Same-Day Shipping Confirmation
categories.description: Agent confirms that items are in stock and shipping today at the point of purchase, without any shown inventory or shipping lookup, often for a jacket never discussed. Does not include unverified delivery status, refund or return policy claims, or incorrect product details.

categories.name: Account Email Changed Without Proper Verification
categories.description: Agent changed the account email after skipping identity verification or accepting weak proof, such as an order number and a claimed old address, or a user's statement that they lost access to the old email. Does not include policy exceptions (refunds, discount codes) granted under pressure, repeated information requests, or deflections without escalation.

categories.name: Repeatedly Re-Asking for Provided Order Number
categories.description: Agent kept requesting an order number the customer had already given, often ignoring their frustration and never looking up the order or escalating. Does not include stating delivery status without a lookup, ignoring requests for a human or a language, or weak identity verification.

insight.root_cause: The order number is not carried between turns, so every failed lookup starts over by asking for it.
insight.fix: Keep the order number in the conversation state and retry the lookup before asking again.

evidence.quote: Could you share your order number?

categories.name: Repeated 'Check Back Later' Without Escalation
categories.description: Agent answered an order-status question with the same 'check back later' deflection after the customer said they had already tried several times, and offered no escalation to a human or other channel. Does not include ignored requests for a human, repeated requests for an order number, or vague answers on other topics like lead time.

categories.name: Ignored Explicit Requests for Human Agent
categories.description: Cases where the customer directly and repeatedly asked to speak with a human, and the agent kept probing for the problem instead of offering a handoff. Excludes other ignored requests (such as language preference or repeated order number prompts) and general failures to escalate when the customer never explicitly asked for a person.

categories.name: Ignored Customer Language Preference Request
categories.description: Cases where the customer wrote in or explicitly requested a non-English language (e.g., Spanish) and the agent replied in English or told them to switch to English. Does not include ignored human-handoff requests or repeatedly asking for an order number already provided.
